FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 249
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/31/2025
Senate Bill 249 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of municipalities to
hold hearings and publish notification of any proposed ordinances to levy a new tax or license
fee or to increase the rate of any existing tax or license fee.
